{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Embrace'' the fear you feel, for in ''me'' you shall find&mdash;eh? Ghhhacck!"<br />"In ''you'' they'll find Bantha dung.|Nobam Nol and Boba Fett, as the latter slays the former|<ref name="twod" />}}
'''Nobam Nol''' was a [[Prophet/Legends|prophet]] who was able to convince the people of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[N'ildwab]] that he was a powerful [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], and as a result garnered a fervent following on the planet. Nol's brief reign of terror and illusion was brought to a halt by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who summarily broke the faux-Sith's neck, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him swiftly.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The ''Sith'' come to me&hellip; I ''am'' the ''Sith''. Those who will not see will ''feed'' me. Those who ''do'' see will be a part of me.|Nobam Nol|<ref name="twod" />}}
Nobam Nol was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] supposed [[Prophet/Legends|prophet]] who had risen to prominence on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[N'ildwab]] by [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. He was able to control the masses through illusions&mdash;by wiring remote explosives to controls within his [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]], Nol could simulate the appearance of generating destruction at will through the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. To that end, Nol posed as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]],<ref name="twod" /> an ancient order to which historical figures such as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], and [[Skere Kaan]] had belonged.<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Nol was specifically recognized by the people of N'ildwab as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], and he commanded fear among the throng of people on the planet. In 5 ABY, outside a [[N'ildwab settlement|settlement]] on the planet, Nol stood atop a pile of [[Death/Legends|corpses]] near a mob of his followers.<ref name="twod" />

As those faithful to him attacked the settlement's walls, Nol began his oration, imploring the people within the settlement to acknowledge his power&mdash;those who denied it would apparently be consumed by Nol's power, while anyone who accepted his control would be a "part" of him. As the "Sith" began firing his remote explosives through his gauntlets, he continued his speech, calling upon the mass of people to embrace their fear of him. At that moment, a new arrival swiftly approached&mdash;the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. The [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] swiftly struck at Nol's throat, breaking the pretender Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord's]] neck and killing him instantly. Fett unceremoniously picked up Nol's body by the ankle and dumped it within the settlement. The settlement's inhabitants were shocked by Fett's ability to defeat a Sith Lord, until the hunter divulged the nature of Nol's deception.<ref name="twod" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Do you see ''who'' has the power?|Nobam Nol|<ref name="twod" />}}
Nol was a skilled orator, able to use both technology and his own presence to inspire others to do his bidding. So powerful were his persuasive skills that he was able to convince a large group of people that he was a Sith Lord, despite using only technology to provide any evidence of the claim.<ref name="twod" />

===Appearance, attire and equipment===
{{Quote|All trickery. His gloves are wired.|Boba Fett|<ref name="twod" />}}
Nol sported bandaged [[Armor/Legends|armor]], a ragged [[Cape/Legends|cape]], and a helmet that kept his face visible. He also wore gauntlets that were capable of triggering remote devices, giving the appearance of someone who had command of the Force.<ref name="twod" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nobam Nol appears briefly in [[Andy Mangels]]' [[1997]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]], ''[[Boba Fett: Twin Engines of Destruction]]''. The character has not appeared in any other works to date.
